name: Government Food Science Training Centre
benefit: The state has two Food Department Training Centres that offer one-and-a-half-year diploma courses in Canning and Food Processing, Bakery and Confectionery, and Cookery.
_eligibility_text: 1. To seek admission in a diploma course, the candidate/student must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. For admission to the Canning and Food Processing course, the student must have passed Intermediate (Science/Agriculture) from an institute located in Uttarakhand. 1. For admission to other courses, the student must have passed Intermediate from an institute located in Uttarakhand.
